headline: Manchester City's seven wins meet unbeaten Aston Villa
summary: Manchester City have won all 7 league games, including at Liverpool, and lead the Premier League with 21 points. Aston Villa beat Newcastle 1-0 on Saturday and are unbeaten in 5, but Aaron Wan-Bissaka is out for 3 weeks with a hamstring injury. City's Erling Haaland is okay to start, his manager said. The market average makes City 55.7% favourites, more than twice Villa's 21.6% chance, and gives Villa a 0.75-goal head start. The market expects 3.0 goals, and more than that is 52.2% likely.
read: Manchester City come to Villa Park as clear favourites at 55.7%, having won all seven of their league games, but Villa are unbeaten in five and have won the last two meetings between the sides. The market expects goals — the total sits at 3.0 with Over at 52.2% — while Villa cover for the absences of Wan-Bissaka and Manzambi and City have Haaland cleared to start.

facts.fact: Manchester City are 55.7% to win at Villa Park — more than twice Aston Villa's 21.6% chance.
facts.meaning: The market makes the away side clear favourites, with Villa given barely a fifth of the chance even at home.

facts.fact: City top the Premier League with 21 points from seven games, having won all seven.
facts.meaning: That perfect league record is the backbone of their price as away favourites.

facts.fact: Aaron Wan-Bissaka is set to miss at least three weeks with a hamstring injury picked up in Villa's 1-0 win at Newcastle.
facts.meaning: Villa must reshuffle their defence for the visit of the league's top scorers.

facts.fact: Villa are unbeaten in their last five matches — WWDWW — with 15 goals scored and 5 conceded.
facts.meaning: They arrive in form and scoring freely, which is why they are not dismissed at home.

facts.fact: Erling Haaland was an unused substitute in City's 5-1 Champions League win over AEK Athens, but manager Enzo Maresca said he is 'okay to start on Saturday'.
facts.meaning: City's main striker is available and comes into this with fewer minutes in his legs than usual.

facts.fact: The market sets the goal total at 3.0, with Over 3.0 at 52.2% after shortening from 50.3% in recent days.
facts.meaning: A game with three goals or more is seen as slightly more likely than not.

facts.fact: Villa won the most recent meeting 2-1 at the Etihad in May, and also beat City 1-0 at Villa Park the October before.
facts.meaning: Villa have won the last two meetings — the market still makes City clear favourites.

facts.fact: City have conceded 10 goals in their last five matches.
facts.meaning: There is a route into this game for Villa even as big underdogs.

sources.fact: Aaron Wan-Bissaka is set to miss at least three weeks with a hamstring injury suffered in Villa's 1-0 win at Newcastle.
Johan Manzambi misses out through injury, though Ian Maatsen has returned to training.
Unai Emery said Villa's injuries are 'no excuse'.
Villa won 1-0 at Newcastle in the Premier League, with Johan Manzambi scoring the only goal.
Villa lost 4-0 at Brighton on 23 August in the Premier League.
Enzo Maresca said of Erling Haaland: 'He's okay to start on Saturday.'
City beat AEK Athens 5-1 in the Champions League, with Phil Foden scoring a hat-trick.
City sit top of the Premier League table, three points clear of Arsenal.
